title: Chevy S10 & GM 7-5/8" Rear Axle Wilwood Forged Dynalite Rear Parking Brake Kit
description:
Convert your drum setup or upgrade your rear disc brakes with the Wilwood Forged Dynalite Rear Parking Brake Kit (140-16445). Engineered specifically for Chevy S10, GMC Sonoma, and GM 7.5" / 7.625" (7-5/8") rear axle housings running a 2.75" axle offset, this kit combines 4-piston stopping power with an internal drum-in-hat parking brake shoe mechanism.

Featuring forged billet Dynalite 4-piston calipers, 12.19" x 0.81" vented iron rotors, and an integrated internal shoe assembly, this kit provides a clean, hidden emergency brake setup without cumbersome external mechanical levers cluttering your rear axle.

#### What’s Included:

* Forged Dynalite 4-Piston Calipers: Finished in durable black powder coat with stainless steel pistons.
* 12.19" x 0.81" Vented Rotors: Plain-face Ultralite HP 32-vane iron rotors with integrated internal parking brake drums.
* Internal Drum-in-Hat Parking Brake Mechanism: Tightly integrated shoe system housed inside the rotor hat for exceptional static holding power.
* BP-10 Smart Pads & Hardware: Street-performance friction pads, axle flange mounting brackets, and grade-8 installation hardware.

#### Key Specs & Notes:

* Axle Fitment: Fits GM 7.5" / 7-5/8" S10 rear end flanges with a 2.75" axle offset.
* Wheel Stud & Bolt Patterns: Rotor hats accommodate popular 5-lug bolt patterns (5x4.5", 5x4.75", 5x5.0").
* Wheel Clearance: Fits most popular 15" and larger rear wheels (verify inner barrel clearance prior to mounting).
* Brake Lines & Parking Cables Required: Flexlines and parking brake cables are not included in this core kit. Requires stainless flexlines with -3AN fittings and custom parking brake cables (such as Wilwood P/N 330-9371).

#### Vehicle / Axle Application:

* 1982–2004 Chevrolet S10 / GMC S15 / Sonoma (with factory GM 7.5" / 7.625" 10-bolt rear end and 2.75" flange offset)
* Custom builds and street/strip swaps utilizing an S10 7-5/8" rear axle housing.
